nodes.label: Local pretrained SBERT with per-category maximum cosine scores
nodes.rationale: The same multilingual SBERT embeds target and reference sentences locally. Each category uses its maximum similarity to a single example. Scores are not probabilities, do not sum to 100%, and the explanatory numeric example is simulated. The filter trains no new classifier and does not send each comment to Gemini.

nodes.label: Ordered relevance decisions and short-sentence uncertainty gate
nodes.rationale: Initial relevance requires score >=0.42 and margin >=0.035; otherwise generic and irrelevant require >=0.42 and a strictly highest score, then uncertain is the fallback. A relevant candidate of at most 14 words becomes uncertain when its relevance score is below 0.60.
nodes.norm_label: ordered relevance decisions and short-sentence uncertainty gate

nodes.label: Verified root and parent context for short uncertain sentences
nodes.rationale: Context is matched through original ID or URL and audited parent relationships with matching checksums and target text; missing or conflicting parents are not guessed by title similarity. Only uncertain sentences of <=14 words with standalone relevance >=0.22 are eligible. Context combines the target with at most 400 parent characters and 650 root-post characters; contextual acceptance needs >=0.50 and margin >=0.035. Clustering still uses the original target sentence.
nodes.norm_label: verified root and parent context for short uncertain sentences

nodes.label: Per-occurrence decisions, source checksums and preserved provenance
nodes.rationale: The four labels are relevant, generic, irrelevant and uncertain; only relevant enters clustering. Audit data preserves occurrence ID, source, scores, margin, reasons and context use. Identical text can receive different decisions in different conversations. Workbook checksums and sentence identity are verified before training selection; full source data and prior snapshots remain.
nodes.norm_label: per-occurrence decisions, source checksums and preserved provenance

nodes.label: Historical relevance results from 2 November 2026
